summary: Frontend-only verification of new Lead ID format (IR + consultant-code + MM + running number) and destination-based auto-allocation. Backend allocation logic is fully working end-to-end, BUT the Users.jsx page is missing critical UI: no Consultant Code input in Add User form and the entire Lead Allocation by Destination section is not rendered (state and handlers exist, JSX markup is missing).
passed: Admin login → /users: 'Consultant Code' column IS present, shows 'RK' for Ravi Kumar (sales@indianrounds.com / SAL001) and 'KA' for Karuva (karuva@indianrounds.com / KAR001).
GET /api/allocations returns the seeded Thailand → Karuva (KA) allocation correctly.
Sales user creates lead with destination='Thailand' → Lead ID = IRKA07003 (starts with IRKA, Karuva's code, NOT IRRK).
Thailand lead detail page: Contact panel shows 'THAILAND · KARUVA · NEW LEAD', Trip Details STAFF field shows 'Karuva'.
Sales user creates lead with destination='Bali' → Lead ID = IRRK07007 (starts with IRRK, Ravi's own code, since Bali is not allocated).
Bali lead detail page: Trip Details STAFF field shows 'Ravi Kumar' — correct fallback to lead creator when no destination-based allocation exists.
Consultant-code prefix in Lead ID correctly reflects the effective owner after backend auto-allocation reassignment.
failed: Add User form is MISSING the 'Consultant Code' input (data-testid='u-consultant'). The form only exposes u-name, u-email, u-password, u-role, u-code (staff-code) and u-add. State field `f.consultant_code` is initialised in Users.jsx but no <Input/> is rendered for it, so an admin cannot set/update consultant_code from the UI at all.

The entire 'Lead Allocation by Destination' section is MISSING from the /users page. data-testid='allocations-section' is NOT in the DOM. Sub-controls a-destination, a-consultant, a-save are all MISSING. No 'alloc-Thailand' pill is rendered even though GET /api/allocations returns the Thailand → Karuva record. The React state (`allocations`, `allocForm`, `destinations`), the load() call to /api/allocations, and the setAllocation/removeAllocation handlers all exist — but the JSX render was never added after the users Table (component ends at line 128).
Console shows two `403` errors on the sales /leads/new page (harmless polling for a forbidden resource, likely /api/users which sales role can't read) — non-blocking but worth cleaning up.

ui_bugs.issue: Consultant Code <Input/> field with data-testid='u-consultant' is missing. State setter exists (f.consultant_code) but no input is rendered.
Entire 'Lead Allocation by Destination' Card is not rendered. Missing data-testids: allocations-section, a-destination, a-consultant, a-save, alloc-<Destination> pills.

integration_issues.issue: Admin cannot create/edit/delete destination→consultant allocations from the UI because the section is not rendered. The backend APIs (GET/POST/DELETE /api/allocations) work — verified via fetch inside the browser — but there is no way to reach them from the /users page.

critical_code_review_comments: Users.jsx (lines 63-131): The component initialises state for `consultant_code`, `allocations`, `allocForm`, `destinations`, defines `setAllocation()` and `removeAllocation()` handlers, and calls the /allocations & /master?category=destination endpoints in load(), but the corresponding JSX is never rendered. Two visible outputs are missing: (a) an Input with data-testid='u-consultant' inside the Add new user form (bound to f.consultant_code, maxLength=2, uppercase on change), and (b) a Card with data-testid='allocations-section' containing a Select data-testid='a-destination', a Select data-testid='a-consultant' listing users where role==='sales' (name — code), a Save button data-testid='a-save', and a list of pills each with data-testid=`alloc-${destination}` for existing allocations with a remove ✕ button.
Backend allocation reassignment works correctly: Thailand → IRKA07003 (owner=Karuva) and Bali → IRRK07007 (owner=Ravi) both verified via UI. No backend action needed.

Non-blocking: Two 403 errors on the sales user's /leads/new page (likely a fetch of /api/users or /api/allocations from Users.jsx that also fires elsewhere). Consider gating those fetches to admin/operations roles only.
action_items: Add the missing 'Consultant Code' <Input/> field with data-testid='u-consultant' inside the Users.jsx Add new user form, bound to f.consultant_code, maxLength=2, auto-uppercase.

Render the entire 'Lead Allocation by Destination' Card with data-testid='allocations-section' below the users Table in Users.jsx. Must include: Destination select (data-testid='a-destination') populated from `destinations`; Consultant select (data-testid='a-consultant') populated from `users.filter(u => u.role === 'sales')` showing 'name (code)'; Save button (data-testid='a-save') calling setAllocation; and a list of pills (data-testid=`alloc-${destination}`) for each item in `allocations`, each with a small ✕ button to call removeAllocation.
Optional: suppress the 403 fetches for /api/allocations or /api/users when a non-admin loads /leads/new (currently no crash but pollutes console).

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only scope, backend paths exercised through UI all returned 200)
success_rate.frontend: 45% (3 of 8 review-request checks pass — column display + Thailand→IRKA + Bali→IRRK all work; but consultant-code input, allocations-section, a-destination, a-consultant, a-save, and Thailand allocation pill are all missing so 5 of 8 checks fail)

test_credentials: admin@indianrounds.com/admin123 and sales@indianrounds.com/sales123 — both valid, from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created two test leads during verification: IRKA07003 (Test AllocUI Thailand, phone 9876524060 — auto-reassigned to Karuva) and IRRK07007 (Test AllocUI Bali, phone 9876517787 — kept with Ravi Kumar). Both can be left as-is for regression or cleaned up by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend allocation is confirmed working end-to-end at the UI level (Thailand lead created via sales user got IRKA prefix and Karuva staff; Bali kept IRRK/Ravi). The remaining work is purely a Users.jsx JSX render gap — main agent needs to add the u-consultant input and the allocations-section Card. All state, handlers, and API wiring already exist in Users.jsx, so this is purely markup work. After main agent adds those, next testing agent only needs to re-verify: (1) u-consultant field accepts max 2 chars & uppercases, (2) allocations-section shows a Thailand→KA pill, (3) admin can add Bali→<sales user> allocation and see the new pill.
rca of the issue: Users.jsx was partially updated: state (f.consultant_code, allocations, allocForm, destinations), API calls (load() fetching /allocations and /master?category=destination), and handlers (setAllocation, removeAllocation) were all added — but the corresponding JSX for the Consultant Code input inside the Add-User form and the entire 'Lead Allocation by Destination' Card below the users Table was never written. Verified by inspecting /app/frontend/src/pages/Users.jsx (only 132 lines, ends at right after the users Table Card) and confirming in the browser that DOM has none of the required data-testids (u-consultant, allocations-section, a-destination, a-consultant, a-save, alloc-Thailand). Mitigation: main agent should render both missing UI blocks in Users.jsx; the API and backend logic are already correct.
